repos_data.description: One memory shared by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw and 29 more coding agents, built from the session history already on disk. A fix found in one agent comes back in any of them, including months of sessions from before you installed it. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.
Let AI agents message, watch, and spawn each other across terminals. Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, Kilo, Pi, Kimi
A Claude Code plugin that teaches your AI agent to remind you to go outside. Weather-aware, sunset-aware, session-aware. Ships an MCP server + SessionStart hook + skill.

VE Harness — run Claude Code for hours without babysitting it. A hosted task board that survives the session, hooks that deny the commit until a review ran, real-time shared memory for your team's agents, and a Docker worker that works your queue overnight.
